scripts.build: pnpm typegen && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node scripts/sync-brand.ts --check && cross-env TINYRACK_WORKERS=1 react-router build
scripts.test:prepared: pnpm test:unit && vitest run --project e2e && vitest run --project e2e-overlays
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && vitest run --project e2e && vitest run --project e2e-overlays
scripts.test:visual-parity: pnpm build:visual-parity && pnpm test:visual-parity:endpoint && pnpm test:visual-parity:motion
scripts.test:visual-parity:endpoint: cross-env TINYRACK_VISUAL_PARITY=full vitest run --project e2e --testTimeout=300000 tests/browser-visual-parity.test.ts
scripts.test:visual-parity:motion: cross-env TINYRACK_VISUAL_PARITY=motion vitest run --project e2e --testTimeout=2700000 tests/browser-visual-parity.test.ts
scripts.test:visual-parity:smoke: pnpm build:visual-parity && cross-env TINYRACK_VISUAL_PARITY=smoke vitest run --project e2e tests/browser-visual-parity.test.ts
scripts.test:visual-parity:quick: pnpm build:visual-parity && cross-env TINYRACK_VISUAL_PARITY=quick vitest run --project e2e tests/browser-visual-parity.test.ts
